.github/workflows/codeql.yml.text:
jobs:
  analyze:
    steps:
      - uses: github/codeql-action/init@2892aa5e19bbd11bc0cff5427e3b750a04d9e3c2 # v4
      - uses: github/codeql-action/analyze@2892aa5e19bbd11bc0cff5427e3b750a04d9e3c2

bin/curl.text:
#!/bin/sh
for argument in "$@"; do printf '%s\n' "$argument" >> '<place>/fake/curl.log'; done
printf '%s\n' -- >> '<place>/fake/curl.log'
output=''
while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
  if [ "$1" = --output ]; then output="$2"; fi
  shift
done
if [ -f '<place>/fake/curl.body' ]; then /bin/cat '<place>/fake/curl.body' > "$output"; fi
exit "$(/bin/cat '<place>/fake/curl.status')"

bin/tar.text:
#!/bin/sh
for argument in "$@"; do printf '%s\n' "$argument" >> '<place>/fake/tar.log'; done
printf '%s\n' -- >> '<place>/fake/tar.log'
if [ "$1" = -tf ]; then
  /bin/cat '<place>/fake/tar.listing'
  exit "$(/bin/cat '<place>/fake/tar.list-status')"
fi
/bin/mkdir -p "$4/codeql"
printf 'analyzer\n' > "$4/codeql/codeql"
if [ -f '<place>/fake/tar.appear' ]; then /bin/mkdir -p "$(/bin/cat '<place>/fake/tar.appear')"; fi
exit "$(/bin/cat '<place>/fake/tar.extract-status')"

for argument in "$@"; do printf '%s\n' "$argument" >> '<place>/fake/curl.log'; done
printf '%s\n' -- >> '<place>/fake/curl.log'
output=''
while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
  if [ "$1" = --output ]; then output="$2"; fi
  shift
done
if [ -f '<place>/fake/curl.body' ]; then /bin/cat '<place>/fake/curl.body' > "$output"; fi
exit "$(/bin/cat '<place>/fake/curl.status')"

bin/tar.text:
#!/bin/sh
for argument in "$@"; do printf '%s\n' "$argument" >> '<place>/fake/tar.log'; done
printf '%s\n' -- >> '<place>/fake/tar.log'
if [ "$1" = -tf ]; then
  /bin/cat '<place>/fake/tar.listing'
  exit "$(/bin/cat '<place>/fake/tar.list-status')"
fi
/bin/mkdir -p "$4/codeql"
printf 'analyzer\n' > "$4/codeql/codeql"
if [ -f '<place>/fake/tar.appear' ]; then /bin/mkdir -p "$(/bin/cat '<place>/fake/tar.appear')"; fi
exit "$(/bin/cat '<place>/fake/tar.extract-status')"
